title: Convert ScheduledUnit/StudyDayPattern/ProjectionResult in overdue_types.dart to @freezed instead of hand-rolled ==/hashCode
rule: File Naming Conventions (never hand-write ==/hashCode for data classes)
why: Every field pairing is currently correct (verified by reading all three operators/hashCodes), so there is no live bug today. But every sibling domain model in the same feature (daily_task.dart, goal_entity.dart, pace_status.dart, schedule_config.dart) uses @freezed, and this file's own doc comment's 'no codegen' rationale doesn't actually require hand-rolled equality — freezed has no Flutter/Riverpod/Drift dependency either. overdue_projection_test.dart's O1/O3/O5 determinism assertions (expect(r1, equals(r2))) depend entirely on this hand-rolled equality staying correctly paired with every future field addition.
recommendation: Convert the three classes to @freezed and regenerate; overdue_projection_test.dart/overdue_durability_test.dart should pass unchanged since the generated == is equivalent.
acceptance_criteria: ScheduledUnit, StudyDayPattern, and ProjectionResult are @freezed classes with no hand-written operator== or hashCode.
overdue_projection_test.dart and overdue_durability_test.dart pass unchanged after the conversion.
